name: Unmei no Kotoba
source:
A voice whispers in your dreams.
Words that can fulfill any desire you may have.
The heroine on the other hand is trouble by androphobia.
They are guided, meet, and fall in love.

有一个声音在你的梦中低语。
可以满足你任何愿望的词语。
另一方面，女主角则因男性恐惧症而烦恼。
他们被引导、相遇并坠入爱河。
